correctness.rationale: FAIL: The reviewed RESULT.md asserts that the exact normalized determinant equals beta*gamma*(gamma²−beta²)=alpha²*xi⁴ and derives beta=(xi⁴/gamma0³)alpha²+O(alpha⁶), Vsurf−Vbulk=−(cs*xi⁷/(gamma0⁶ S'(k0)))alpha⁴+O(alpha⁸). The cited Gourgiotis–Georgiadis arXiv:1509.06590 Eq.(40), visually verified on page 16, actually gives beta*(ell² gamma²−abar3 xi²)²−gamma*(ell² beta²−abar3 xi²)²=0. Its Eq.(56) defines alpha=abar3/ell². The exact reduction (for beta≠gamma) is beta*gamma*(gamma²+beta*gamma+beta²−2alpha xi²)=alpha² xi⁴, NOT the audited determinant. For fixed characteristic-root functions S,T as stipulated in the audited proof, gamma=gamma0+O(beta²) and beta=(xi⁴/gamma0³)alpha²+(2xi⁶/gamma0⁵)alpha³+O(alpha⁴). The cubic coefficient is nonzero for xi,gamma0>0. Squaring to obtain k-k0 consequently generates a nonzero order-alpha⁵ phase-speed correction. Thus both O(alpha⁶) and O(alpha⁸) remainders in the *submitted final claim* are false. An independent symbolic expansion of the source determinant confirmed the missing order-alpha³ term (when cubic beta is omitted, the determinant has coefficient −2xi⁶/gamma0 at alpha³). The leading quadratic beta and quartic speed coefficients may survive after substantive repair, but no complete corrected research files and renewed final claim were supplied.
